run_ipw_weighting: run inverse propensity weighting to compute adjusted sample weights using a target population
run_ipw_with_custom_model: run inverse propensity weighting with a custom sklearn classifier like HistGradientBoostingClassifier
extract_model_coefs: extract coefficient values and intercept from a fitted sklearn logistic regression model
transform_probabilities_to_log_odds: transform predicted probabilities into log odds using the link function
choose_regularization_parameters: choose the best regularization lambda and weight trimming via grid search on ASMD improvement
